```lean
theorem lg_target {α : Type*} (s : Set α) (f : α → α) (hf : ∀ x, f (f x) = x) : f '' (f '' s) = s := by
  apply eq_set_iff
  constructor
  · intro x
    rw [image_eq]
    apply forall.intro
    intro y
    rw [image_eq]
    apply forall.intro
    intro z
    rw [mem_image]
    rcases mem_image.1 z with ⟨a, ha⟩
    rcases mem_image.1 y with ⟨b, hb⟩
    rcases mem_image.1 x with ⟨c, hc⟩
    exact hf c
  · intro x
    rw [image_eq]
    apply forall.intro
    intro y
    rw [image_eq]
    apply forall.intro
    intro z
    rw [mem_image]
    rcases mem_image.1 z with ⟨a, ha⟩
    rcases mem_image.1 y with ⟨b, hb⟩
    rcases mem_image.1 x with ⟨c, hc⟩
    exact hf c
```
